title: derive.py fetch --limit takes newest first, so PRs whose rework window just closed are never fetched
problem: Reviews run `fetch --limit 300`, newest first. About 200 PRs merge a day, so the 300 fetched are all under 14 days old, and PRs merged 14 to 21 days ago (the only ones `build --history-days 21` can measure) stay unfetched. Rework coverage only grows from PRs fetched long ago.
evidence: prompts/derived/github.json 2026-11-28: merged PRs cached for 11-01..11-09 and 11-27..11-28; 1 for 11-10..11-26
change: Have fetch with --limit first take unfetched PRs that merged 14 to history-days ago (or split the limit between those and the newest).
metric: rework measured rows added per review
